name: tiresias
description: Tiresias — Intelligent Knowledge Discovery and Visualization System (Phase 1 foundation)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run dev --workspace=backend --if-present || (cd backend && npm run dev)
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run dev --workspace=frontend --if-present || (cd frontend && npm run dev)
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:e2e --prefix frontend
